design_concept.description: A blend of a curated travel magazine and a modern directory app. Uses a warm sand background to enable soft Neumorphic dual shadows (raised and inset surfaces). Emphasizes large, immersive destination photography, generous whitespace, and organic structural shapes. Avoids generic tech-blues and purples in favor of warm sand, jungle green, and sunset orange. Captures the essence of North Sumatra.

headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, Hero text, editorial pull quotes. Conveys the 'travel magazine' elegance.

body.usage: Paragraphs, UI elements, labels, buttons, navigation. Crisp and readable inside Neumorphic elements.

layouts.neumorphic_card: rounded-3xl bg-[#F3F1EC] p-6 sm:p-8 transition-all duration-300 shadow-[8px_8px_16px_#D8D4CC,-8px_-8px_16px_#FFFFFF]

NeumorphicButton.classes: px-8 py-4 rounded-full bg-[#F3F1EC] text-[#1A2F24] font-semibold transition-transform transition-shadow duration-300 hover:text-[#DE6B48]
NeumorphicButton.notes: Use for primary actions. Do not use flat background colors for the button surface; rely on the dual shadow for depth on the warm sand background.

NeumorphicInput.classes: w-full bg-[#F3F1EC] rounded-2xl px-6 py-4 outline-none text-[#1A2F24] placeholder-[#5C6C63] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#DE6B48]/30 transition-all
NeumorphicInput.notes: Input fields and search bars must use the inset shadow to look carved into the background.

DestinationCard.structure: Raised Neumorphic container -> Image (rounded-2xl, object-cover) -> Content padding -> Title (Playfair) -> Details (Location/Price) -> Action button
DestinationCard.image_treatment: Large photo taking up 60%+ of card height. No heavy dark overlays on the entire card, keep it bright and tropical.

CategoryFilter.style: Horizontal scrollable list of pill-shaped Neumorphic buttons. Active state uses inset shadow + Accent Sunset Orange text.

Navigation.style: Floating Neumorphic pill-shaped header or soft raised bar. Sticky at top with z-50. Include bilingual toggle (ID/EN).

visual_enhancers.border_radius: Use generous rounding. rounded-2xl for inner elements, rounded-3xl or full for main containers/cards/buttons.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) to match the elegant travel magazine feel. Duotone or Light weights.
visual_enhancers.cultural_motifs: Subtle background SVG patterns using traditional Batak Ulos geometric shapes (very low opacity, e.g., 3-5%) in empty spaces or footer.
visual_enhancers.photography: Large, borderless images within the Neumorphic cards. Use object-cover and aspect ratios that feel editorial (e.g., 4:5 for cards, 16:9 or panoramic for hero).

motion.hover: Hovering on a raised Neumorphic card slightly increases the shadow blur and distance (lifting it). e.g. hover:shadow-[12px_12px_24px_#D8D4CC,-12px_-12px_24px_#FFFFFF]
motion.active: Clicking a Neumorphic button swaps its box-shadow to `inset`, giving a tactile physical pressing effect.
motion.page_transitions: Smooth fade in for destination images to feel premium.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the Jungle Green text (#1A2F24) against Warm Sand (#F3F1EC) maintains high contrast.
accessibility.focus_states: Focus rings on inputs should be visible. Use the Sunset Orange (#DE6B48) for focus rings (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#DE6B48]/50`).
accessibility.aria: Add aria-labels to icon-only buttons (like the wishlist heart).

media.3d_libraries: Not recommended. The Neumorphic UI and high-fidelity photography carry the visual weight.
media.map_integration: For the map location display, use standard React-Leaflet (`yarn add leaflet react-leaflet`). Style the map tiles to be light/warm if possible.

instructions_to_main_agent: Extend tailwind.config.js to include the custom Neumorphism shadows in the theme.extend.boxShadow section (e.g. `neu-raised: '8px 8px 16px #D8D4CC, -8px -8px 16px #FFFFFF'`, `neu-inset: 'inset 6px 6px 12px #D8D4CC, inset -6px -6px 12px #FFFFFF'`, `neu-pressed: 'inset 4px 4px 8px #D8D4CC, inset -4px -4px 8px #FFFFFF'`).
Use standard React/Tailwind for the main structural UI. Instead of Shadcn default cards which have standard borders, implement the custom Neumorphic shadow classes.
For interactive form elements (Dropdowns, Dialogs), use Shadcn UI but aggressively override their default styles (remove borders, apply #F3F1EC background, add Neumorphic shadows).
Do NOT use pure white (#FFFFFF) for the main background. Neumorphism strictly requires an off-white background (use #F3F1EC) so both light and dark shadows are visible.
Do NOT use standard CSS borders. Neumorphism relies on shadows for edges.
Implement the bilingual toggle (ID/EN) state in the application header.
Use react-leaflet for the map location display.
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="search-button"`).
Include `.js` and `.jsx` specific logic where needed, avoiding typescript specific code since the repository uses `.js` files.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' outputs.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12) than typical designs.
Add transition effects to all interactive elements, but avoid `transition: all`. Use specific properties.
Do not center align the app container. No `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Never use placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image_urls.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds in headers/dropdowns; use solid #F3F1EC or glassmorphism if absolutely necessary (but solid is better for Neumorphism).
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Maintain a clear visual hierarchy using typography (Playfair for elegant headers, Manrope for readable body).
Ensure touch targets on mobile are large enough (min 44x44px).
Use inset shadows for 'empty' or 'receptive' states (inputs, depressed buttons, search bars).
Use raised shadows for 'active' or 'content' states (cards, floating action buttons, standard buttons).
Ensure consistency across all pages (Homepage, Detail Page, Favorites, Admin).
